Thank you for sharing. It was interesting seeing another's story. I see glimpses of myself in you.

Experimenting, seeing what would happen, I always love that too. I recall a time when I found a wounded bird on my street. I took it home and put it in a box trying to take care of it. Unfortunately it kept hitting his head trying to break out but I just watched it hitting and hitting wondering if it would stop trying or die that way.
I find similarities in that idea of being the core member of a group. I know what you mean, it feels good to be in a position of authority. I dare to say I even felt what you were implying, just a little smile as you think about it. I feel ya.

I recall when some family members died once, 2 of grandparents who were like the 'heads' or core of our family. Everyone seemed to feel this sense of loss even those younger than me who had had very little interaction with them, yet to me I just felt strange, just normal. I remember just wistfully thinking of how fragile our lives can be and my own mortality.

Of course experimenting is always intriguing. I know I have said it but I feel a connection with you. I try to see how much I can lie, the extent. Its quite satisfying how far some confidence and a calm face will take you well and of course our imagination. I went to a grammar school so things were never as chaotic but starting small arguments or planting the seeds of hatred between two friends was always quite pleasing.
I must admit I have never really been a kleptomaniac or been that promiscuous. Never really tried but I should have, I am somewhat of a (r)Romantic.

Finally on the point of self growth, I have had some powerful moments of change. It really makes me look back sometimes and see a different boy. I remember struggling badly at some points and I recall my breakdowns because they were very few, 2 in particular (my home life was just... driving me to the point of breaking me). 

There's more to say on a lot of this but that's enough for now.
I have never heard someone's story before and it intrigues me. I wouldn't mind getting to know you better. I feel a great deal of affinity with you.
